BEFORE YOU CALL

Service
information.

What vehicles and equipment do you service?+

Sampson Heavy Diesel Services takes servicing and repair enquiries for trucks, heavy equipment and agricultural machinery. Call with the make, model and work required so Clive can confirm suitability and availability.

Can I arrange field service for a breakdown?+

Call Clive on 0474 372 852 with your location, equipment details and what has happened. He will discuss availability and whether field service is suitable for the job.

Do you support individual owners and fleets?+

Enquiries are welcome from individual equipment owners, transport fleets, civil contractors, agricultural businesses and workshops. Discuss equipment numbers, maintenance priorities and timing directly with Clive.

Which areas do you cover?+

Enquiries are welcome across Victoria, including Melbourne and regional areas. Travel, site access, work location and availability are confirmed for the particular job.

Can I arrange help in Victoria if I am elsewhere?+

Yes. If the truck or machine is in Victoria, you can enquire from another state or country. Provide its Victorian location, equipment details and a contact person on site. Clive will discuss availability, access, work approval and the next step. From outside Australia, call +61 474 372 852.

Can I arrange transmission or component work?+

Call with the vehicle, machinery and component details, plus the symptoms or condition. Clive can discuss assessment, repair or rebuilding suitability and the next step.

How do I arrange planned maintenance?+

Provide the vehicle or machine list, service history, kilometres or operating hours, location and preferred dates. Clive will discuss the work, schedule and availability before a booking is confirmed.
